name: Fold plan
description: A drawing sheet that folds from a flat plan into a tilted model, with a sun slider that recasts every shadow and parts you open as a card.

labels.name: Product name
labels.icon: Brand icon address (empty uses the built-in FormCAD icon)

propDocs.parts: Array of {t, type, ws, flag, img: {640, 1024}, alt, d, exp, tag: [x, y, z], parts: [{x, y, w, d, h, z?, g?, m?}]} in list order. Boxes sit on a 200 by 128 plan; g adds a gable rise, m is b or c for the darker and lighter materials.
propDocs.nav: Array of {label, href} for the header links.
propDocs.text: Object that overrides interface words: view, plan, axon, sun, parts, hintTurn, hintMove, copy, copied, of, drafting, modelling, type, workspace, saves, savesValue, exports, prev, next, close, about, download, north, scaleUnit.
propDocs.name: Product name; a leading Form is drawn in ink and the rest in the product tint.
propDocs.sunStart: Sun hour from 6 to 20; 17.5 is half past five.

fallback: Under reduced motion every transition and entrance animation is switched off and the sheet shows its settled state; the plan and axon switch, the sun slider and the part cards stay usable. Without CSS 3D support the flat plan still shows.
